name: @red-cup-engineering/agent-lifecycle-hook-service
description: The one agent-lifecycle hook boundary: a runtime-neutral AgentLifecycleEvent decoded from what Codex or Claude Code puts on a hook's stdin, a typed AgentLifecycleResponse encoded back into that runtime's wire shape and exit code, and one stdio adapter under which every hook handler is a pure operation over the typed event. No handler parses stdin, argv, or emits a wire shape itself.

scripts.check: node --check src/index.mjs && node --check src/types.mjs && node --check src/event.mjs && node --check src/response.mjs && node --check src/pending-text.mjs && node --check scripts/run-agent-lifecycle-hook.mjs
